entities.summary: Alexei Andreevich Bondarev is a Russian professional ice hockey defenceman who is now retired. He most recently played under contract with Avangard Omsk in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He previously played with HC Spartak Moscow for a second stint after previously appearing with HC CSKA Moscow from Traktor Chelyabinsk and formerly Metallurg Magnitogorsk He signed a one-year contract with CSKA on May 14, 2014.
